entries.name: Awesome Recursion Schemes
entries.description: A curation of useful resources for learning about and using recursion schemes.

entries.name: Practical Recursion Schemes
entries.description: Introduction to pattern functors, fix points, anamorphisms, catamorphisms, paramorphisms and hylomorphisms, requiring very little prior knowledge.

entries.name: An Introduction to Recursion Schemes
entries.description: Three-part series in which you discover recursion schemes from scratch and implement a small subset of Edward Kmett's library.

entries.name: Understanding Algebras
entries.description: Bartosz Milewski explains F-algebras and shows how to use them in the context of catamorphisms.

entries.name: Recursion Schemes in JavaScript and Flow
entries.description: Series introducing recursion schemes and related concepts in JavaScript, aimed at developers with a minimal functional programming background.

entries.name: Recursion Schemes: A Field Guide (Redux)
entries.description: List of various recursion schemes with code samples.

entries.name: Catamorphisms
entries.description: Definition on the Haskell Wiki.

entries.name: Catamorphisms
entries.description: Short definition with code on School of Haskell by Edward Kmett.

entries.name: Rotating Squares
entries.description: Using a hylomorphism to rotate a quadtree by Jared Tobin.

entries.name: Recursion Schemes, Part V: Hello, Hylomorphisms
Promorphisms, Pre and Post
entries.description: Practical examples of pre- and postpromorphisms by Jared Tobin.

entries.name: Time Traveling Recursion Schemes
entries.description: Exploring histo and futu by example by Jared Tobin.

entries.name: Recursion Schemes, Part IV: Time is of the Essence
entries.description: Practical article about histomorphism and the futumorphism.

entries.name: Cheat Sheet
entries.description: Map of various recursion schemes and their duals.

entries.name: Correcting the Visitor pattern
entries.description: Showing that the Visitor pattern implements an f-algebra for use with a catamorphism (in Java).

entries.name: Recursion Schemes in Scala
entries.description: Introduces the fixpoint combinator, anamorphism, catamorphism, hylomorphism, paramorphism, apomorphism, histomorphism, dynamorphism and futumorphism.

entries.name: What's in a Fold: The Basic Catamorphism in recursion-schemes
entries.description: Introduces catamorphism as a generalization of fold.

entries.name: Stalking a Hylomorphism in the Wild
entries.description: Advent of Code 2017, Domino challenge

entries.name: Open Seasons on Hylomorphisms
entries.description: Advent of Code 2018, String comparison challenge

entries.name: Functional Programming with Bananas, Lenses, Envelopes and Barbed Wire, 1991, Meijer et al.
entries.description: The original paper most of this is based on.

entries.name: A Duality of Sorts, 2013, Hinze et al.
entries.description: Shows that many basic sorting algorithms exist as a pair, and that these pairs arise naturally out of the duality between folds and unfolds.

entries.name: Sorting with Bialgebras and Distributive Laws, 2012, Hinze et al.
entries.description: Shows how paramorphisms and apomorphisms can be used for more efficient implementations of sorting algorithms.

entries.name: Scrap your boilerplate: a practical design pattern for generic programming, 2003, SPJ et al.
entries.description: Design pattern for writing programs that traverse data structures built from rich mutually-recursive data types.

entries.name: Slidedecks by Tim Philip Williams
entries.description: "Recursion Schemes by Example" and "Exotic Tools for Exotic Trades" provide concise definitions as well as practical examples of many recursion schemes.

entries.name: Unifying Structured Recursion Schemes
entries.description: 12 min presentation by Ralf Hinze, Nicolas Wu, and Jeremy Gibbons.

entries.name: Recursion Schemes
entries.description: Presented by Tim Williams at the London Haskell meetup.

entries.name: F-algebras or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Type System
entries.description: Presented by Anthony Burzillo at the NYC Haskell User's Group.

entries.name: A Gentle Introduction to Recursion Schemes
entries.description: Presented by Jean Remi Desjardins at Lambdaconf 2016.

entries.name: recursion-scheme-talk
entries.description: Collection of slide decks about recursion schemes.

entries.name: Bracer: Transforming Real-World Languages with Coproducts and Recursion Schemes
entries.description: High-level talk about structuring programs with coproducts and recursion schemes by Patrick Thomson.

entries.name: Recursion: Where Functional Programming Hits Bottom
entries.description: Introduction to recursive fix point data structures and recursion schemes in Haskell and Scala by Greg Pfeil.

entries.name: Programming with algebras
entries.description: Bartosz Milewski's article in talk form, presented at LambdaCon.

entries.name: Peeling the Banana: Recursion Schemes from First Principles
entries.description: Zainab Ali's Introductory talk presented at LambdaWorld.
